meta.agreement: agreedBy counts teams marked 'proposed' or 'agrees'; 'reconciliation' is this pass's own check and is not counted.

findings.title: Most curated card chins sit on the mouth, so those plates are about 25 % too tight
findings.evidence: On 6 cards read on a 0.01 grid (Merlwyb 87065, Nanamo 87063, Thancred 87046, Miounne 87030, Lucia 87089, Alisaie 73036) the curated chin is the lip line; the true chin span is 1.26-1.49 x the curated one. Rendered: the real chin falls at about 0.92-0.94 of the plate (the rim). Trust busts were curated to the true chin (Thancred 72623, Urianger 72625, G'raha 72637, Emet-Selch 72648).
findings.effect: The reconciled finals use the true chin, so card faces shrink about 20 % on the plate and gain the crown band. Owner question Q7.

teams.A: silent (its readings follow the curated plates)
teams.C: silent (its chin errs the other way)

findings.title: Team C's detector chin sits below the jaw on painted art
findings.evidence: 18 hand readings: true span = 0.80-1.03 (median 0.87) x the detector span; on Garland 3D renders it is the true chin (8 of 8).
findings.effect: Game finals use eye + 0.87 x (detector chin - eye).

findings.title: Team A's readings anchor to the crop they were read on
findings.evidence: Where a curated crop was wrong, Team A read the eyes where the curated entry put them: Hien 87202 (dx 0.21), Raubahn 87067 (0.21), Fourchenault 87338, Tansui 87214, Thancred 87165, Y'shtola 87166, Magnai 87195. On pack photos where Team C's detector missed, Team A was right in 13 of 14 checked (the hooded Crystal Exarch 1028108 is unclear).
findings.effect: Team A wins on Team C review-status pack photos; Team C wins on confident ones (8 of 8 checked).

findings.title: Team B's basis is the same as A's and C's; its disagreements are readings
findings.evidence: B's suggested [u, v] are hr texture fractions (its 'today the eyes sit at' figures are plate %, and they convert to the same texture values). Its eye x points at the head's centre or the far eye in three-quarter views (Wuk Lamat 0.57 vs true 0.405, Venat 0.27, Koana 0.42, Alisaie 72622 0.60, Alphinaud 72638 0.50), and its Estinien v 0.259 is the nose (eyes at 0.205).
findings.effect: B measurements were outvoted on every crop; its lore and body-model findings drive the era changes.

findings.title: Most pack photos Team C could not read hold a face the builder missed
findings.evidence: Team C's detector re-run on an enlarged region around each of its 367 review-status photos found a face in 335 (276 with both detectors); 10 of 12 random ones checked by eye are right. The rest are helmets, masks, creatures, or a weapon with no head.
findings.effect: Their reconciled boxes are starting points for the overlay page (still review); only 6 photos are proposed for --skip outright.

findings.title: Team counts of quests differ by basis
findings.evidence: Team A counts quests a character appears in (Wuk Lamat DT: 112 MSQ); Team B and C count quests a portrait is worn on as giver (36). Both are kept per row in reconciled.json.

iconCrops.note: Curated-format entries from reconciled.json. 'ready': confidence >= 0.78 and not flagged; 'provisional': on the owner's overlay page first. Every other curated entry stays as it is.

codeChanges.function: PortraitIndex.For(uint, byte, byte) and PackWins; PortraitSources.Rank
codeChanges.change: Let the pack win only when the game pick is None, or when the picked icon has no curated crop and no curated face. Give PackWins the variant (icon + source) and the crop table; 'curated' = Crops has an icon entry (PortraitCrops needs a HasIconCrop(icon)) or the face came from PortraitCuration.Faces. Keep Rank(Pack) = -1 for the uncurated case. Update the spec-1.20 F4 note and the PackWins tests.
codeChanges.evidence: Y'shtola 1026571 (staff) replaces curated bust 72626 on 146 MSQ quests; Estinien 1036120 (lance) replaces 72644; Lyna 1028865, Zero 1042980 likewise.

teams.C: agrees (pack fixes must otherwise go through the builder)

codeChanges.title: Cast plates: three faults
codeChanges.change: (a) Do not take the first known row of member.NpcIds (a SortedSet: the lowest id, an ARR row): pick the member row that appears in this quest (the cast reader knows the quest's script rows), else the row whose giver quests are of the quest's era, else the latest row not after the era. (b) Replace `break` with `continue` when a row has no art, so a later row's art is tried before initials. (c) For a cast member with no giver row the index knows, look the face up by name: add PortraitIndex.ForName(string name, byte era) that runs Match on a synthetic PortraitGiver (generic=false, race 0) and Pick by era. (d) Pack photos used on plates must carry the photo row's own era, not the quest's: PortraitIndex.For stamps packEra = the quest era, so the shield never hides a later-look photo.
codeChanges.evidence: 63 MSQ rows wrong era on plates (Team A). Spoiler-grade: Emet-Selch's ShB quests show his Elpis photo; Lahabrea's ARR quest shows the unmasked Keyward; Arenvald, Honoroit, Magnai, Fourchenault in ARR show later looks. Members with art but no giver row: Count Edmont 87093, Meteion 87337, Hakuro 73116, Gigi 87181, Coultenet 73171/87122, Wilred 73198, J'moldva 72791, Frixio 87035 (all measured in reconciled.json).

codeChanges.title: The pack head crop frames low and takes weapons for crowns
codeChanges.change: The chin is the neck's narrowest row, below the real chin, so eyes land at a median 0.574 of the box (target 0.43) and the chin at 0.87. Fix the vertical: eyes = neck - 0.62 x head (was chin - 0.48 x head) and chin = neck - 0.14 x head, or equivalently move boxTop down by 0.134 x square and shrink only while the box stays >= MinBox. Fix the crown: require the crown row's opaque run to be contiguous and at least 0.35 x head wide for 3 consecutive rows, and reject a candidate crown whose row centroid is more than 0.4 x head from the centroid of the rows below it (a raised staff or lance). Keep MinFilled. Verify on the 22 photos in reconciled.json flagged by two or more teams, and against the reconciled boxes (median eye line should come to 0.42-0.46).
codeChanges.evidence: Team C: 895 confident photos, median eye 0.574, chin 0.87; 578 off-centre and 163 cut photos on 1,992 quests. Team A: 167 photos, median eye 62 %, 9 of 156 in band; weapon crowns on Y'shtola, Estinien, Zero, J'olhmyn.

codeChanges.title: `Pick` should choose the era before the family
codeChanges.function: PortraitIndex.Pick (and the variant sort in Match)
codeChanges.change: Pick the latest era not after the quest's across all families; break ties by family rank; keep TrustStrip last (only when no other family has a face of that era or earlier). Sort variants by era desc, rank asc. Needs BLOCK-3 (Raubahn 73031) first, and makes PIN-1, PIN-3 and PIN-8 unnecessary. Test cases: Tataru EW (73072 over 87241), Zero DT (73274 over 72651), Yugiri SB (73081 over 87084), G'raha ARR (still none), Raubahn SB (73130 or the ARR card, never 73031).
codeChanges.evidence: Tataru EW/DT, Zero DT, Yugiri SB-EW, Cid HW-EW (Team A cause E; Team B cause 3).

teams.C: disagrees: calls earlier looks reused in later arcs acceptable

codeChanges.title: Trust-bust family default only fits ShB busts
codeChanges.change: Every bust a quest shows now has a reconciled iconCrop, so this matters for new busts. Split the default: icons 072621-072637 keep (6, 86, 140) (median reconciled ShB box 13, 77, 143); 072638 and up use (24, 58, 135) (median reconciled EW/DT box). Needs a per-range default (e.g. PortraitCrops.DefaultFor(source, icon)) and a test.
codeChanges.evidence: Eyes under the default box: Wuk Lamat 0.04-0.06, Varshahn 0.04-0.08, Estinien 0.08-0.11, Zero 0.13, Venat 0.21 (all three teams).

codeChanges.title: Two-person cards need a crop per giver
codeChanges.change: Allow a curated face to carry its own crop: faces { '87062': { name: 'Nashu Mhakaracca', source: 'TripleTriadCard', eyes: [...], chin: ... } } keyed by icon plus name (e.g. key '87062/Nashu Mhakaracca'). PortraitVariant gets an optional crop; For uses it before Crops.For(source, icon). Cards: 87062 Hildibrand & Nashu, 87210 Raubahn & Pipin, 87059/87251/87341 the twins, 87122 Hoary Boulder & Coultenet, 87033 Biggs & Wedge, 87048 Papalymo & Yda, 87044 Raya-O-Senna & A-Ruhn-Senna.
codeChanges.evidence: Nashu: 22+ quests with no art; the twins' ARR card is blocked for both (Alphinaud ARR 53 MSQ, owner question Q8).

codeChanges.title: Per-NPC override in the pack builder
codeChanges.change: Read a curated packBoxes map { '<photo ENpc id>': { box: [x, y, side], note } } (Garland photo px) and resample that box instead of PortraitHeadCrop.Crop; still enforce MinBox and write the box to the manifest. Seed it from reconciled.json: pack rows with review false and final.action change (the C3 fix may make most redundant: rebuild, then keep overrides only where the C3 box and the reconciled box differ by more than 0.05 of the plate).
codeChanges.evidence: Garland photo boxes in reconciled.json; 9 photos in packSkip.skipUntilOverride need it to come back.

codeChanges.title: Looks change by patch: a look key by ENpcBase body model
codeChanges.change: Read each giver's ENpcBase look (ModelChara, ModelBody/ModelHead or NpcEquip) into PortraitGiver.LookKey. Add curated looks { '<look key>': { icon, source, note } }; Match checks it after pins and before name matching. About 30 body models cover the major characters (Team B's npcmodels.tsv). Replaces PIN-2, PIN-6, PIN-7 and BLOCK-1.
codeChanges.evidence: Twins 5.4-6.0 (18 quests), Alphinaud 3.0 before Iceheart (6), Tataru 4.56-5.x (3) and 6.0+ (6), Estinien 5.4 (1).

teams.A: agrees (its wrong-era test compares these same fields)
